sources.title: Jonauskaite et al. — Universal Patterns in Color-Emotion Associations
sources.use: Emotional associations show broad similarities and cultural variation. The proposed individual meanings are design suggestions, not measured psychological effects.

sources.title: IBM Carbon — Color palettes
sources.use: Categorical colors should differentiate discrete items; inspect the sequence and neighboring colors together. This is an original palette, not an IBM palette.

sources.title: Material Color Utilities
sources.use: Use perceptual color models and explicit color roles. This proposal uses OKLCH, not HCT or wallpaper-derived dynamic color.

sources.title: W3C — Understanding Use of Color
sources.use: Folder names and icons must also communicate identity; color is an additional cue.

audit.metric: Euclidean OKLab distance times 100; comparative design diagnostic only
audit.limitations: Not user recognition testing. Twenty colors cannot be assumed distinct for every viewer. Labels and icons remain required. Theme-role contrast applies to the authored backgrounds, not all wallpaper-derived themes.
